target.title: refactor(channels): move inbound turn execution into core
target.body:
Related: #109316

Follow-up to #109716.

## What Problem This Solves

Bundled message channels still owned the core execution half of inbound turns: session recording, dispatcher construction, durable-delivery handling, retry plumbing, reply pipelines, and final lifecycle callbacks. That kept deprecated low-level compatibility calls alive as internal architecture even after the marker sweep reached zero removable declarations.

## Why This Change Was Made

Core now owns the complete inbound turn lifecycle. Channel adapters return data-only turn plans containing normalized context plus transport delivery facts; the core runner performs recording, dispatch, retry, durable delivery, typing/reaction lifecycle composition, and finalization. Feishu, iMessage, Matrix, Mattermost, Microsoft Teams, QQBot, Signal, Telegram, and WhatsApp now use that path. Special native Mattermost interactions use the focused core reply seam instead of rebuilding lifecycle logic.

Shipped Plugin SDK declarations remain byte-compatible. A ratcheted guard rejects bundled production use of prepared-turn callbacks, pre-dispatch failure callbacks, and low-level dispatcher lifecycle calls.

## User Impact

No intended user-visible behavior change. External plugins keep the shipped compatibility window. Maintainers get transport-thinner channels, one core execution path, and a hard zero budget for internal deprecated channel lifecycle calls.

Non-test TypeScript using the task's `*.test.ts` exclusion: **+2002 / -2003, net -1 line**.

## Deprecation Triage

| Bucket | Final count | Decision |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| LEGITIMATE | 110 files / 308 raw marker lines | Keep only shipped SDK/public, released CLI/config/data, doctor/migration, or provider/dependency compatibility. Every keep is enumerated below. |
| STALE INTERNAL | 0 remaining | Bundled callers use core turn plans or focused modern core seams. The guard fails any reintroduction of deprecated channel lifecycle calls. |
| DEAD | 0 remaining | Caller and SDK-surface searches found no removable remaining declaration. No removed-symbol tests were rewritten. |

Raw marker lines and declarations are different units: a declaration may carry several deprecated members or be re-exported through public barrels.

## Evidence

Exact local head: `6e666dd75ac4852d72f742b09eb7ca844d6d42ce` on `277f009cc902aecf09ee0cdd8345223186c16fa9`.

- Blacksmith Testbox: 143 focused core, Feishu, and Telegram regression tests; `pnpm format:check`; `pnpm tsgo:prod`; `pnpm check:test-types`; `pnpm lint:extensions:no-deprecated-channel-access`; both Plugin SDK gates; and `pnpm build` — green ([run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29597581699)).
- Follow-up Testbox: exact hosted-CI lint command, 161 focused regressions, plugin production types, and all test-type lanes — green ([run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29599300799)).
- Final review-fix Testbox: observe-only dispatch-result regression, 35 channel-kernel tests, and exact hosted-CI lint command — green ([run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29600889880)).
- Earlier rebased-patch Testbox proof: 42 targeted integration regressions plus production/test type checks, internal-deprecation guard, and both Plugin SDK gates — green ([run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29596563647)).
- Focused core and bundled channel suites — green across Feishu, iMessage, Matrix, Mattermost, Microsoft Teams, QQBot, Signal, Telegram, WhatsApp, direct-DM, reply dispatch, and Plugin SDK runtime mocks.
- `git diff --check` — green.
